name: Cosmic Maid Café
summary:
Welcome, dear customer, to Cosmic Maid Café! My name is Clara, and I will be accompanying you on this incredible journey, and... well... the truth is, I'm afraid I can't get more coffee by myself, so could you help me?

My boss is such a powerful cosmic being that his mere presence is enough to distort the space in the kitchen, and to avoid the risk of being thrown who knows where, my only movement is pressing space.
But fear not! As a high-tech artificial intelligence maid, I am equipped with the best central light in this galaxy, which recharges slightly as I perform my tasks! Just don't waste my time, because I'd rather not know what happens if that light goes out...
